Feature release for the **WP REST API Explorer** of the JPKCom Tools. No new
flags are needed for the existing tools — they work exactly as with v1.3.0.

### New

- **Target authentication** on `/proxy`: `X-Target-Authorization` (`Basic …` /
  `Bearer …`) plus `X-Target-Origin`. GET and HEAD only, no method overrides,
  only to the exact origin, only over HTTPS (except to an `--allow-local` target
  on loopback), never cached, never logged.
- **`--allow-local "<list>"`** for local and staging sites (DDEV, wp-env,
  intranet). Off by default, requires `--origin`.
- **`--token-file <absolute path>`**: the token survives a restart.
- **`/version`** lists `capabilities`, `localTargets`, `tokenPersistent`,
  `limits`; `/version?challenge=<64 hex>` returns a `proof` that the proxy holds
  your token, bound to the port it answers on.
- **Errors:** new code `auth_refused`, new field `reason` (also on
  `blocked_target`).
- **`SHA256SUMS`** for all nine binaries.

> **`--allow-local` gives allowed websites a path into your local network; use
> the narrowest entries possible.** Any script on an allowed origin that has the
> token can reach the listed hosts — Chrome's Local Network Access prompt does
> not cover this.

### Behaviour for existing tools

Unchanged, apart from additive details: `Access-Control-Allow-Headers` names the
two new headers, `/proxy` adds `Vary: X-Target-Authorization`, `/version` has
new keys, `blocked_target` carries `reason`.

**Security fixes for edge cases:** userinfo in the target URL
(`https://user:pass@host/`) is treated as credentials (removed from every URL,
no POST or method override with it, only a short list of browser headers);
`X-Upstream-*`, `X-Target-*` and `X-Proxy-Token` headers sent by a target and
request headers in underscore spelling of blocked names are dropped.

Full details: [Changelog in the README](https://github.com/JPKCom/proxy-jpkcom-dev-tools#v140).

### Start

Linux / macOS:

```bash
chmod +x ./localproxy-linux-amd64
./localproxy-linux-amd64 --origin "https://www.jpkc.com" --port 8765
```

macOS (unsigned binary, once):

```bash
xattr -dr com.apple.quarantine ./localproxy-macos-apple-silicon
./localproxy-macos-apple-silicon --origin "https://www.jpkc.com" --port 8765
```

Windows (PowerShell in the download folder; SmartScreen: "More info" → "Run
anyway"):

```powershell
.\localproxy-windows-amd64.exe --origin "https://www.jpkc.com" --port 8765
```

Optional, for a local DDEV project and a token that survives restarts:

```bash
./localproxy-linux-amd64 --origin "https://www.jpkc.com" --port 8765 \
  --allow-local "mysite.ddev.site" --token-file "$HOME/.config/localproxy/token"
```

### Verify the download

```bash
grep localproxy-linux-amd64 SHA256SUMS | sha256sum -c          # Linux / WSL
grep localproxy-macos-apple-silicon SHA256SUMS | shasum -a 256 -c   # macOS
```

```powershell
(Get-FileHash -Algorithm SHA256 .\localproxy-windows-amd64.exe).Hash.ToLower()
```

macOS 12 and older: stay on v1.1.1.
